name: note
description: Notes as the shared record between developer and agent, backed by the track CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Keep the developer and the agent on the same page in a track vault.
interface.longDescription: A track vault is where the developer and the agent record what they both need to know: decisions, findings, and outstanding work. These skills create and search notes, write bodies in track's Markdown dialect, clip web pages into the vault, record incoming project work as checklist items, file research reports, and keep a plan and worklog for the work an agent carries out.
defaultPrompt: Use $track-create-note to create a linked note in my vault.
Use $track-project-intake to record this bug/TODO in my project's note.
Use $track-report to write up what you found as a report note.
Use $track-news-analysis to research this event from multiple lenses and file an analysis note.
Use $track-watch to run today's light brief (or this week's mid/high review) for my watch topic.
Use $track-task-runner to work through my project note's checklist.
Use $track-markdown to write this note body in track's Markdown dialect.
Use $track-clip to read this URL and save it as a note.
Use $track to rename a note and update backlinks.
